relationships.subject: axitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: HCl instillation increased the expression of tyrosine kinase receptors, including VEGFR-2 and PDGFR-B; axitinib administration inhibited their expression.

relationships.subject: axitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral administration of axitinib improved pain, voiding profiles, and urothelial integrity by inhibiting angiogenesis in IC rat model.

key_findings: IC patient bladders showed increased VEGFR-2 and PDGFR-B staining, with no difference in VEGF.
Oral axitinib improved pain threshold, voiding and histology in HCl-induced IC rats and reduced VEGF/PDGF pathway expression.
